normalization.private_charter_method: Convert a published whole-vessel charter into a fare-per-rider equivalent by dividing by 5.2 modeled riders. This makes modeled trip revenue equal the published charter price at 65% occupancy. Retain the operator's minimum booking block; time-scale only trips longer than that block.
normalization.warning: These are local premium marine analogs, not claims that an operator currently serves each exact Navier origin-destination pair. Exact-OD fare evidence remains null where absent.
